brain: canonical Shiu LIF model on FlyWire v783 (unmodified), interactive chunked runtime (d7_runtime.py)

encoder.note: triangular hemifield tuning; bilateral centre zone

decoder.note: frozen after D8 calibration; same config for intact and shuffled-motor conditions

controls.shuffled_sensory: each channel drives a wrong same-size random subset of LC9 U LPLC2 U LC4 (seeded per episode)
controls.shuffled_motor: decoder population slots permuted (seeded per episode), brain and interface intact

gate3_criteria.G3_1: intact closed loop: reproducible neural->motor actions that change the environment; target-approach success clearly above the random control
gate3_criteria.G3_2: shuffled sensory control degrades vs intact
gate3_criteria.G3_3: shuffled motor control degrades vs intact
gate3_criteria.G3_4: random controller substantially worse than intact if meaningful behavior exists
gate3_criteria.honesty: if the fixed brain does not outperform controls, report FAIL - no post-hoc tuning to force a pass
